scenes.name: RATCHET
lines: A ratchet turns one way. Errors in print can survive for decades. In Lean, unsolved tactic goals stop a proof before kernel checking.
棘轮单向转。文中的错能流传几十年。Lean 策略留下未解目标，证明就到不了内核。
Every theorem added to a catalog intersects the joint kernel of indistinguishable states—blind spots can shrink, never grow.
每向目录加入一条定理，不可分辨状态对的联合核就取一次交——盲区只缩不胀。

scenes.name: NOVELTY
lines: A theorem lowers information escape on a nondegenerate arena if and only if it lies outside the others’ semantic closure.
在非退化竞技场上，定理降低信息逃逸，当且仅当它在其余定理的语义闭包之外。
You cannot mine the same gold twice.
同一块金子，挖不了两次。

scenes.name: THE FROZEN RECORD
lines: On November 27 the independent research institute, The Omega Institute, counted 223,231 frozen Lean 4 theorems in trureturing.
11 月 27 日，The Omega Institute 统计到 223,231 条冻结 Lean 4 定理。
The ledger dates 2,276 resolutions across 81 days. Two undated entries bring the total to 2,278.
81 天内有 2,276 项带日期的题解，加上两项无日期记录，共 2,278 项。
It records 1,512 proofs and 766 refutations. Quantum and physics account for 598 entries.
其中 1,512 项获证，766 项被反驳。量子与物理占 598 项。
All 720 UTC hours saw commits, with a median of 63 per hour.
连续 720 个 UTC 小时均有提交，每小时提交数中位数为 63。
The last seven full days averaged 217 merged pull requests a day.
最后七个完整日平均每天合入 217 个 PR。

scenes.name: PROOF AND REPLAY
lines: The November 21 joint statement certified Levent Alpöge’s Lean proof of classical RH.
11 月 21 日的联合声明认证了 Levent Alpöge 对经典黎曼猜想的 Lean 证明。
Independent audits checked five theorems, including his Dirichlet GRH results.
独立审计核查了五条定理，其中包括他对狄利克雷广义黎曼猜想的结果。
The Omega Institute replayed the proof in 8,490 shards.
The Omega Institute 以 8,490 个分片复现了证明。
Separately, trureturing proves that classical RH is equivalent to an integer Hankel criterion.
trureturing 另证了经典黎曼猜想与一个整数 Hankel 判据等价。

scenes.name: OPEN QUESTIONS
lines: Extended RH for Dedekind zeta functions and Grand RH for automorphic L-functions remain open.
戴德金 ζ 函数的扩展黎曼猜想与自守 L 函数的大黎曼猜想仍待解决。
So do simplicity of the nontrivial zeros and their pair correlation. Each is a different question about the zeros.
非平凡零点是否均为单零点，以及它们的对关联，也各自是独立的开放问题。
